honesty.play: Paths and side stories are play. They are kept on this device only, certify nothing and never enter a completion record.
honesty.quotes: Every line a path or a side story shows from a pack is quoted verbatim from that pack's registry, with its source; which parish shows which quote is a play layout, not a fact.
honesty.un: "UN training" is a PROPOSED module of this game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. It uses no UN emblem and no UN course. It shows only respond/ items whose own text is about humanitarian themes.
honesty.k12: Cognition.X K-12 districts stay PROPOSED partners: no district has reviewed or agreed.
honesty.lessons: Lessons are unverified general practice, exactly as the lessons pack states.
honesty.crash: No path or side story rewards crashing a vehicle.
honesty.econ: City-life steps use PLAY COINS only, never money; every lot is an AUTHORED game lot of the economy pack, not a real property, address, listing or business.

steps.quote: explore at home, build and practice in class, verify unaided; the teacher circulates instead of lecturing

steps.title: Explore at home
steps.quote: the lesson positions of the module pack, sequenced by the skill graph with the ZPD difficulty dial, in any of the eight shipped languages

steps.title: Build in class
steps.quote: station bench work - checklists, doctrine lines and machine-gradable quizzes at the hall stations - plus the district crib drill at the tools-room pegboard (match the job to the tool, graded deterministically), with the teacher moving bench to bench

steps.title: Practice on the floor
steps.quote: simulator seat time with the regional scenario of the campus - live dash, synthesized sound, deterministic rubric; results and best times persist device-locally

steps.title: Verify unaided
steps.quote: assessment gates certify only unaided work; no home exploration, class bench or simulator hour substitutes for the unaided verification run
